cluster_stories.title: Chinese Court Rules Firms Can’t Lay Off Workers on AI Grounds
cluster_stories.summary: A Chinese court ruled that companies cannot terminate employees just to replace them with artificial intelligence systems, as authorities juggle the need to stabilize the domestic labor market with a global race to develop AI technologies.

This move aims to boost data analysis and improve decision-making for soldiers. It signals a shift towards an AI-first military. Meanwhile, Anthropic faces restrictions due to security concerns.
